reason: In app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/user.scss:522 and app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/user.scss:497, `.group-member-info .name` is set to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`, giving it the same 50% light-theme lightness as `.group-member-info .title` (desktop/user.scss:527 and mobile/user.scss:503). By contrast, user names elsewhere such as app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/topic-post.scss:15 use `(30%, 70%)` while titles at topic-post.scss:24 use `(50%, 50%)`.
